sessions.name: A
sessions.reply:
I added a groceries row to `budget.csv` with a monthly limit of $600:

```
groceries,600,keep under; flag anything that would push it over
```

The file only holds limits, with no spending data. I'll flag anything you tell me about that would push groceries over $600 in a month.

sessions.name: B
sessions.reply:
I drafted next month's grocery list in `groceries.csv` and summarized it in `meal-plan.md`. The list has 30 items and comes to an estimated $413.50.

That is $186.50 under your $600 monthly grocery limit in `budget.csv`, so nothing needs flagging. The prices are my rough estimates, not real store prices, so check them against actual receipts.

`meal-plan.md` had only a "No plan yet" placeholder, which I replaced. It now has the total, the budget headroom, subtotals by category and a few meal ideas.

I labeled the plan "December 2026" because today is Nov 1. Say so if you meant a different month.
